title: Everyday Phrases — Online Shopping
scene_zh: 網上購物 · 情境對話
title_quote: I want to buy headphones online.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🛒 實用網上購物必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Online Shopping
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的網上購物情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從搜尋比價、看評價挑規格，到湊單免運、輸入優惠碼、選付款方式，再到追蹤物流、收貨驗貨與退貨換貨，全程用得到的英文短句都有。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Online Shopping phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). From searching, comparing prices and reading reviews, to building the cart, applying coupon codes and choosing payment, all the way to tracking the package, receiving it and handling returns or exchanges. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to buy headphones online.
dialogue.zh: 我想在網上買一副耳機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, let's compare some stores.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我們來比較幾家商店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we open the shopping app?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, apps often hide the best deals.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs æps ˈɔfən haɪd ðə bɛst dilz/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，App上常藏著最優惠的價格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll tap the search bar.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type sports headphones, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, thousands of results already!
dialogue.zh: 哇，已經有上千個結果了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's sort them by customer rating.
dialogue.zh: 我們按買家評分排一下序。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pair is the cheapest so far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pɛr ɪz ðə ˈtʃipɪst soʊ fɑr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap ones break faster, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, let's read the reviews.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll open the three-star ones first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈoʊpən ðə θri stɑrz wʌnz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我先開三星的評價看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do those reviewers say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The battery dies in one hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's useless for long runs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's skip it and keep looking.
dialogue.zh: 跳過這款，我們繼續往下看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This brand appears twice already.
dialogue.zh: 這個品牌已經出現兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe runners really love it.
dialogue.zh: 也許跑友們真的很喜歡它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four point six stars, not bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two thousand reviews back that up.
dialogue.zh: 兩千條評價撐得起這個分數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do buyers post real photos?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, on real ears, not studio shots.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɑn ril ɪrz nɑt ˈstudijoʊ ʃɑts/
dialogue.zh: 有，是真實佩戴照，不是棚拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The photos match the ad exactly.
dialogue.zh: 實拍跟廣告圖一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a genuinely good sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some reviews are super long, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過有些評價寫得特別長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll read only the helpful ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This review got eighty helpful votes.
dialogue.zh: 這條評價拿到八十個「有幫助」按讚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it first, it must be solid.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt fɜrst ɪt mʌst bi ˈsɑlɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One woman ran with these daily.
dialogue.zh: 有個女士天天戴著它們跑步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What was her final verdict?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says they never fall out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that's my biggest fear.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那正是我最擔心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real feedback beats fancy ads.
dialogue.zh: 真實評價比漂亮廣告可靠多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, now let's compare prices elsewhere.
dialogue.zh: 說得對，再來別處比比價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is ours cheaper on that site?
dialogue.zh: 那個網站上我們這款更便宜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, theirs costs five dollars more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they offer free shipping there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for paid members, sadly.
dialogue.zh: 可惜只有付費會員才有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our site ships free over fifty.
dialogue.zh: 我們這個網站滿五十美元就免運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's just stay and save.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this pair come in black?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus blue and also red.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which color suits me better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue looks fresh, if you ask me.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu lʊks frɛʃ ɪf ju æsk mi/
dialogue.zh: 問我的話，藍色看起來很清爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a banner at the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen percent off today only!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can customers stack two coupons?
dialogue.zh: 優惠券可以兩張疊加嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually just one per order.
dialogue.zh: 一般一個訂單只能用一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll remember that for checkout.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now let's study the specs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It clearly says waterproof here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, sweat won't damage them.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，汗水不會弄壞它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does one charge last?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About eight hours, the page says.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That covers my longest runs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it charges fully in thirty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪt ˈtʃɑrdʒiz ˈfʊli ɪn ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 而且三十分鐘就能充飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it connect to my old phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt kəˈnɛkt tə maɪ oʊld foʊn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bluetooth pairs with almost anything.
dialogue.zh: 藍牙幾乎什麼都能配對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there any warranty included?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One year for factory defects.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if they break next week?
dialogue.zh: 要是下週就壞了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just message their support team.
dialogue.zh: 直接聯繫他們的客服團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reviewers say their chat is fast.
dialogue.zh: 評價說他們的在線客服反應很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That matters when tech acts up.
dialogue.zh: 設備出毛病時這就很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check the seller's own score.
dialogue.zh: 再來查查這個賣家自己的評分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety-eight percent positive feedback.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold by the brand or a stranger?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld baɪ ðə brænd ɔr ə ˈstreɪndʒər/
dialogue.zh: 是品牌直賣還是陌生賣家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The official store, so it's safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fake sellers copy popular items.
dialogue.zh: 假賣家會山寨熱銷商品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So always check who ships it.
dialogue.zh: 所以一定要看清是誰發貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw a slick ad on social media.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ə slɪk æd ɑn ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmidiə/
dialogue.zh: 我在社群平台上看到一個很精緻的廣告。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those links are often scams.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better to use a trusted platform.
dialogue.zh: 最好還是用值得信賴的平台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buyer protection is worth it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With it, returns cost nothing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, full refund if something's wrong.
dialogue.zh: 對，只要有問題就全額退款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has this item been cheaper before?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tracker says yes, last month.
dialogue.zh: 價格走勢顯示上個月更低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it drop again soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe at the big holiday sale.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But my old pair just died.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then paying a little more is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈpeɪɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr ɪz faɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save them to my wishlist first.
dialogue.zh: 先把它們存進我的願望清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, they're safe on your account.
dialogue.zh: 好了，已經存在你的帳號裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the app notify me of sales?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ði æp ˈnotəˌfaɪ mi ʌv seɪlz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, switch on price alerts.
dialogue.zh: 會，把價格提醒打開就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my phone just buzzed.
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，手機剛剛震了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A flash sale just started!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are our headphones included?
dialogue.zh: 我們那副耳機在活動裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twelve dollars off right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flash sales end at midnight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So let's decide before sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've thought enough—they're the one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still the blue pair, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue, definitely, no second thoughts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice for a runner.
dialogue.zh: 對跑者來說是個好選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for hunting deals with me.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你陪我一起找優惠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime—shopping's fun together.
dialogue.zh: 隨時都行，一起逛才好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready to build the actual order?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First we fill the cart properly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll add the headphones now.
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在把耳機加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, the cart icon shows one.
dialogue.zh: 你看，購物車圖示顯示一件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it save the blue color?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, blue with the medium pads.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I liked how those looked.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我就喜歡那個樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now check the stock status.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says only three left in stock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz ˈoʊnli θri lɛft ɪn stɑk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's finish before they're gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a waitlist if it sells out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈweɪtlɪst ɪf ɪt sɛlz aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 賣光了可以登記等補貨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the app pings you on restock.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ði æp pɪŋz ju ɑn ˈriˌstɑk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glad we came early today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Popular colors sell out fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I grab a second pair?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One for running, one for home?
dialogue.zh: 一副跑步用、一副在家用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly the idea I had.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pairs get a bulk discount.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much off when buying two?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten percent when quantity hits two.
dialogue.zh: 湊到兩副就折百分之十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then set the quantity to two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The line total just dropped nicely.
dialogue.zh: 這件的小計剛剛變少了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's our cart total now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just under forty dollars together.
dialogue.zh: 加起來還不到四十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, shipping is still charged?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free shipping starts at fifty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're twelve dollars short.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add something useful to reach it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I really need a running hoodie.
dialogue.zh: 我真的很需要一件跑步帽T。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Search hoodies from this same brand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This gray one looks so cozy.
dialogue.zh: 這件灰色看起來好舒適。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read the fabric details below.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's a soft cotton blend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great for cool morning runs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What sizes do they run?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra small through double extra large.
dialogue.zh: 從加小一直到大加大都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I usually wear medium.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, check the size chart.
dialogue.zh: 但還是先對一下尺寸表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip, charts differ by brand.
dialogue.zh: 說得對，每家的尺寸都不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My last hoodie fit super tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chart says medium fits me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then go with medium, simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reviews say it runs large, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? Maybe go one size down.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？也許該降一個尺碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small might fit me better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's read a review about fit.
dialogue.zh: 我們找一條講版型的評價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One guy ordered his usual size.
dialogue.zh: 有人按自己平常的尺碼訂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did he conclude?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says it fits loose on him.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz ɪt fɪts lus ɑn hɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then small is your size.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Switch the hoodie to small now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the cart updated itself.
dialogue.zh: 好了，購物車自己更新了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the blue hoodie exist too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's sold out except in large.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gray matches the headphones nicely.
dialogue.zh: 灰色跟耳機搭起來很好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep gray, final answer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I also want those running socks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add them or save for later?
dialogue.zh: 要現在加購還是先存著？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saving is fine, my cart's full.
dialogue.zh: 先存著就好，購物車滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, one item moved to saved.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a carrying case?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's only four dollars more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add one, I lose things easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the cart it goes, done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The total is fifty-one dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free shipping unlocked at last!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That saves the four-dollar fee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, money back in your pocket.
dialogue.zh: 對啊，等於錢回到你口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the hoodie shrink when washed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash it cold, it won't shrink.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I hate shrinkage surprises.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我最怕洗縮的驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This brand pre-shrinks the fabric.
dialogue.zh: 這牌子的布料有預縮處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the zipper strong on it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reviews call the zipper solid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the hood—does it stay up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə hʊd dʌz ɪt steɪ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 還有帽子部分撐得起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it keeps its shape well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the cart looks quite full.
dialogue.zh: 現在購物車看起來挺滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's review each line, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two blue headphones, one gray hoodie.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plus the case—shipping is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, did we keep two cases?
dialogue.zh: 等等，我們加了兩個盒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just one case, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does the final total read?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty-one dollars, all items in.
dialogue.zh: 五十一美元，全算進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair prices for all of this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and shipping costs zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What delivery speeds can we pick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Standard, express, or same-day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does standard take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four days, and it costs nothing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Express costs six dollars more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It arrives within two days, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can wait, standard is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That keeps our total lower.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I choose a delivery day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, any weekday next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday works—I'm home Fridays.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday delivery, noted there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we double-check everything?
dialogue.zh: 要不要再把全部檢查一遍？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, one more careful pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sizes, colors, quantities all correct.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cart is perfect, let's go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap the checkout button on the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ðə ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt ˈbʌtən ɑn ðə raɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're on the secure payment page.
dialogue.zh: 我們已經在安全的付款頁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See the little lock icon there?
dialogue.zh: 看到那個小鎖頭圖示了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it means your data stays private.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt minz jʊr ˈdeɪtə steɪz ˈpraɪvət/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First it shows our order summary.
dialogue.zh: 首先畫面上是訂單摘要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four items, just like the cart.
dialogue.zh: 四件商品，跟購物車一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my email address correct here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的電子郵件地址對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's yours, every letter's fine.
dialogue.zh: 是你的信箱，每個字母都對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receipts will land in that inbox.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check spam if nothing arrives.
dialogue.zh: 沒收到的話去垃圾郵件頁看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's enter the shipping address.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll type, you read it aloud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start with our street and number.
dialogue.zh: 先從街道和門牌號碼開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the map already found it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget the apartment unit.
dialogue.zh: 別忘了公寓的門牌戶號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unit seven B, added below.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Couriers sometimes need the door code.
dialogue.zh: 快遞有時需要門禁密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a notes box for that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll write, leave it at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl raɪt liv ɪt æt ðə dɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that saves a second trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we save this address too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, future orders fill automatically.
dialogue.zh: 要啊，以後下單會自動帶入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: City and zip code come next.
dialogue.zh: 接著是城市和郵遞區號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The form completed those by itself.
dialogue.zh: 表單自己把兩欄填好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue checkmarks mean the address is valid.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ˈtʃɛkˌmɑrks min ði əˈdrɛs ɪz ˈvælɪd/
dialogue.zh: 藍色對勾表示地址有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our whole address passed the test.
dialogue.zh: 我們的地址全部通過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it asks for a delivery day.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt æsks fər ə dɪˈlɪvəri deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 現在它請我們選送貨日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday, right? Select it again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday is highlighted in green.
dialogue.zh: 週五已經被標成綠色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our delivery day, locked in.
dialogue.zh: 那就是我們的送貨日，定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before paying, let's find a coupon.
dialogue.zh: 付款前先找一張優惠券。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Search for site codes online.
dialogue.zh: 到網上搜這個網站的優惠碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This deal site lists working codes.
dialogue.zh: 這個優惠站上列的都是有效碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copy the newest one, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I paste the code?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the box right under the total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə bɑks raɪt ˈʌndər ðə ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 就在總額下面那個欄位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm typing it very carefully.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Codes are case-sensitive, remember.
dialogue.zh: 記得，優惠碼區分大小寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says code applied, yes!
dialogue.zh: 它顯示優惠碼已套用，耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten percent off just kicked in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The total dropped by five dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth the one-minute code hunt.
dialogue.zh: 花一分鐘找碼太值得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we use a second code too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi juz ə ˈsɛkənd koʊd tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The box only accepts one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pity, the student code was bigger.
dialogue.zh: 可惜學生優惠碼折得更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe save it for next order.
dialogue.zh: 說不定留著下次下單用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now choose a payment method.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your old card is still saved.
dialogue.zh: 你的舊卡還存在帳號裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But that card expired last spring.
dialogue.zh: 但那張卡去年春天就到期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delete it and add the new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈlit ɪt ænd æd ðə nu wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card number, then expiry month.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the three digits in back.
dialogue.zh: 還有卡片背面的三位數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's that tiny code called again?
dialogue.zh: 那個小密碼叫什麼來著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The CVV, right of the signature.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˌsi vi ˈvi raɪt ʌv ðə ˈsɪɡnətʃər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, everything is entered.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set this card as your default.
dialogue.zh: 把這張設成你的預設卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about paying with my phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phone wallets work on this site.
dialogue.zh: 這個網站支援行動錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No typing numbers with a wallet.
dialogue.zh: 用錢包就不用輸入卡號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One fingerprint and it's paid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a phone payment safe here?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡用手機付款安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very safe, no card number shown.
dialogue.zh: 很安全，完全不顯示卡號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's use the wallet, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose digital wallet down below.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's asking for a billing address.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just tap same as shipping.
dialogue.zh: 點「與收貨地址相同」就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That saved some typing again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forms love that shortcut option.
dialogue.zh: 表單最愛這個快捷選項了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Final total before we pay?
dialogue.zh: 付款前的最終總額是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just under fifty dollars, all in.
dialogue.zh: 不到五十美元，全部含在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That includes tax and shipping?
dialogue.zh: 稅金和運費都算進去了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, no surprise fees now.
dialogue.zh: 是的，已經沒有意外費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm pressing place order.
dialogue.zh: 好，我要按下「送出訂單」了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do it—I'm holding my breath.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The page says processing now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't close the tab, wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A big green check appeared!
dialogue.zh: 出現一個大大的綠色對勾！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your order is confirmed at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows an order number here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡顯示了一組訂單編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Screenshot it, just in case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, filed in my notes app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The receipt email should arrive soon.
dialogue.zh: 收據郵件應該馬上就會到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My inbox is still empty, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過我的信箱還是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a minute, then refresh.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, at last!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it and check the details.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Items, price, Friday—all matching.
dialogue.zh: 商品、價格、週五，全部對上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we're completely set today.
dialogue.zh: 那今天就樣樣都搞定啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the page offer gift wrap?
dialogue.zh: 那個頁面有提供禮品包裝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for two extra dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, this haul is all for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðɪs hɔl ɪz ɔl fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 不用了，這一大包都是買給自己的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Self-gifting is self-care, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，送自己禮物也是照顧自己。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel oddly proud right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your first flawless online order.
dialogue.zh: 你的第一筆網購訂單零失誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we simply wait for Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tracking link will appear soon.
dialogue.zh: 物流追蹤連結很快就會出現。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I track the package?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your account, orders, then tracking.
dialogue.zh: 在帳號的「我的訂單」頁裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check it tomorrow morning.
dialogue.zh: 我們明天早上再來查看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, shopper, sleep tight.
dialogue.zh: 現在先睡吧，愛買的人，晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning! Time to check tracking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It already says package shipped.
dialogue.zh: 它已經顯示包裹發出了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that was fast for online.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, it even shows the route.
dialogue.zh: 看，它甚至畫出了運輸路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It left the city warehouse last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lɛft ðə ˈsɪti ˈwɛrˌhaʊs læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚它離開了市區的倉庫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next stop is our local depot.
dialogue.zh: 下一站就是咱們的本地貨運站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The progress bar is already half full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɑɡrɛs bɑr ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi hæf fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 進度條已經走完一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each segment means one step done.
dialogue.zh: 每一格代表完成了一個環節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does in transit mean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your box travels between stations.
dialogue.zh: 你的包裹正在各轉運站之間跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the courier call before arriving?
dialogue.zh: 快遞送到前會打電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, but don't count on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I turned on every delivery alert.
dialogue.zh: 我把所有送貨提醒都打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, my phone just buzzed too.
dialogue.zh: 真好，我的手機剛剛也震了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says arrived at the facility.
dialogue.zh: 它說包裹抵達轉運站了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the depot near your home.
dialogue.zh: 那就是你家附近的那個站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday, and it still says Friday.
dialogue.zh: 週四了，預計送達還是週五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's exactly the day we picked.
dialogue.zh: 那正是我們挑好的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I have errands Friday noon.
dialogue.zh: 可我週五中午要外出辦事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check if you can change the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ɪf ju kæn tʃeɪndʒ ðə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 看看能不能改送貨日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's an option called reschedule.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it and pick Saturday instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday I'll be home all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it shows Saturday now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Customer service is decent today.
dialogue.zh: 今天的服務系統還挺給力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? No phone call needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning, where is it?
dialogue.zh: 週六早上，包裹到底在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still in transit, be patient.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh—out for delivery now!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means a van carries yours.
dialogue.zh: 那就代表貨車上有你那份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far away is the truck?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The map says eleven stops away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It moved three blocks closer!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This live map is oddly fun.
dialogue.zh: 這個即時地圖好玩得離譜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The estimate reads two to four hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɛstəmət ridz tu tə fɔr ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 預計還要兩到四個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, breakfast while we wait.
dialogue.zh: 正好，我們邊等邊吃早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, it says delivery attempted.
dialogue.zh: 等等，狀態變成「嘗試派送」了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did anyone ring our bell?
dialogue.zh: 有人按我們家的電鈴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody! I never left the couch.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人啊！我根本沒離開沙發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, a card under the door.
dialogue.zh: 看，門底下塞了一張單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says he'll be back Monday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday? That feels forever.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll request a Sunday redelivery.
dialogue.zh: 我來申請週日重新派送。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, add a note about calling first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs æd ə noʊt əˈbaʊt ˈkɔlɪŋ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 好，加備註請送貨前先來電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote: call on arrival, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drivers appreciate clear simple notes.
dialogue.zh: 司機很感謝清楚簡單的備註。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday came, and nothing arrived.
dialogue.zh: 週日到了，卻什麼都沒送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday, the truck came at ten.
dialogue.zh: 週一貨車十點開到門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two boxes on our doorstep!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them in, check the labels.
dialogue.zh: 快搬進來，核對一下標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One label says headphones, one hoodie.
dialogue.zh: 一個標籤寫耳機，一個寫帽T。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both arrived, lucky you today.
dialogue.zh: 兩件都到了，你今天真幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tape holds a free sample.
dialogue.zh: 膠帶上還黏著一份小贈品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, red ear tips, your size.
dialogue.zh: 不錯耶，紅色耳塞，正是你的尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's open the headphones first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, don't rip the box open.
dialogue.zh: 小心點，別把盒子撕爛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, they look brand-new and clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ðeɪ lʊk brænd nu ænd klin/
dialogue.zh: 打開來，耳機全新又乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue, exactly like the photos showed.
dialogue.zh: 藍色的，跟照片上一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The carrying case feels sturdy too.
dialogue.zh: 收納盒摸起來也很結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zip it—nothing rattles inside.
dialogue.zh: 拉上拉鏈，裡面不會晃響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm pairing them with my phone now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈpɛrɪŋ ðɛm wɪð maɪ foʊn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在要把耳機連手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Connected already? How's the sound?
dialogue.zh: 一下子就連上了？聲音如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crisp highs, punchy bass, wow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best purchase this year!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The spare pair works perfectly too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep one at home, smart move.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the hoodie—time to try it!
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈhʊdi taɪm tə traɪ ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fingers crossed for a good fit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tag reads large, not small.
dialogue.zh: 吊牌上寫的是大號，不是小號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They shipped the wrong size!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This thing swims on me.
dialogue.zh: 這件我穿起來空蕩蕩的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start a return in the app.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a returns tab at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə rɪˈtɜrnz tæb æt ðə ˈbɑtəm/
dialogue.zh: 頁面最下面有個退貨分頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose a reason from that list.
dialogue.zh: 從清單裡挑一個退貨原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrong item received—that's the truth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now upload a photo with the label.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˌʌpˈloʊd ə ˈfoʊtoʊ wɪð ðə ˈleɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 接著上傳一張有吊牌的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One snapshot and submitted!
dialogue.zh: 隨手一拍，申請就送出了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any reply from support yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Approved already, in ten seconds!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Automated checks are that fast.
dialogue.zh: 系統自動審核就是這麼快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay the return shipping?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, their mistake ships free.
dialogue.zh: 不用，他們發錯退貨免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It made a printable return label.
dialogue.zh: 它生成了一張可列印的單據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print it at home or a shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɪnt ɪt æt hoʊm ɔr ə ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 在家或找商店列印都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The corner store prints for cheap.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stick the label on the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taped the box, dropped it off.
dialogue.zh: 封好退貨箱，送去貨運站了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the drop-off receipt safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The staff scanned it with a smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stæf skænd ɪt wɪð ə smaɪl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it's officially on the road.
dialogue.zh: 那就代表它正式上路回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refunds take about five days.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The money returns to your wallet.
dialogue.zh: 錢會退回你的行動錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I exchange it instead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, an exchange is way faster.
dialogue.zh: 可以，換貨比退款快得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then exchange—send me that small.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new one ships within a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nu wʌn ʃɪps wɪˈðɪn ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 新的那一件一天內出貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This whole thing taught me patience.
dialogue.zh: 這一整趟讓我學會了耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And to read the size tag twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd tə rid ðə saɪz tæɡ twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 還有尺碼吊牌要確認兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time next shopping week?
dialogue.zh: 下個購物週我們再一起逛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you need those socks!
dialogue.zh: 除非你真的缺那雙跑步襪！
